Making a Difference Trust: Tygerberg

By: TEST ACCOUNT | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The Carte Blanche Making a Difference Trust

Unique Selling Point:
Tygerberg Hospital in Cape Town is the main referral tertiary hospital for over 50 % of the Western Cape children. Although Tygerberg has a neonatal and paediatric unit ICU, both are oversubscribed and cannot cater for all the children. Now with Carte Blanche will be handing over a site to what will a dedicated two-bed ICU specifically for pre and post-operative care of neonates and children. As you will know Carte Blanche has facilitated the construction of a dedicated neonatal and Paediatric operatic theatre for children to receive cardio-thoracic surgery, the construction of this new ICU will ensure the children are provided with better all-round care.

Script:


Making A difference trust

- Visuals of Children in hospital –Thula song

V/O Cape Town’s Tygerberg Hospital is one of the busiest in the country.More than 7000 babies are born here every year , sadly about a fifth of them will need surgical procedures,but ultimately the hospital battles under the sheer weight of numbers.
V/O That’s why in 2018 the Carte Blanche making a difference Trust decided to lend a helping hand - by building a brand new paediatric operating theatre.
- Visuals ribbon cutting (Tygerburg story)- buzz
V/O Now the Trust is embarking on yet another ambitious project at the hospital , this time the creation of a two- bed Cardiothoracic Neonatal and Paediatric ICU unit which will cater to children with Congenital heart ,chest or lung conditions. Marking the 20th Hospital project undertaken to date
V/O For Paediatric Cardiothoracic surgeon Professor Jacque Janson and Pulmonologist Professor Pierre Goussard the ICU unit couldn't come soon enough.
Upsound Professor Janson:03:22 in the western cape ICU bed space is at a premium, you have a lot of sick children coming to the hospital, what would often happen is ,: we would book a patient for theatre and the ICU bed would be full // you have to postpone a case until bed becomes available
Upsound Prof Goussard : 0:23 the value of having a dedicated ICU care is that they will have single rooms , they will be protected from infections and they will have optimal monitoring , these patients are at risk for infection , so they have their own dedicated specialised care and its first world care what we will be able to offer these patients here in the future
V/O In Light of the Corona-19 pandemic this year, the Carte Blanche Making a difference trust...decided to do just that ...make a difference by releasing over R4 million worth of specialized medical equipment before the commencement of the project to aid during this trying time.
Goussard Upsound:05:15 we got equipment just before the COVID period, it was a video icubiscope , we used that equipment for every COVid positive child that needed to be incubated because that’s the safest way of doing it , so we already used that equpent during the covid time
- Bit of breathing room-
V/O It's early morning and I am privileged enough to be invited to scrub in and join Professor Janson and his team, as they perform corrective surgery on a 3 month old baby , its also a chance see the donated medical instruments being put to good use ,
Upsound Dr Janson 04:12 This child presented with shortness of breath and also very noisy breathing , so Pierre Goessard the Pulmonologist, he scoped the child and that where he saw the airway was very narrow and was and was compressed by this pulsating vessel and we can see that on her CT scan.
MacFarlane Question:All this equipment is new , you’ve never had it before?
Upsound Prof Janson 0:13, Obviously that helps us do the job well, because like any operation , you need the right instruments to do the right work//04 So we will be probably be using all of this and obvisously we will be using all the fine instruments , including the retractors
V/O This is an intricate operation , Dr Janson and his team work with the utmost precision and care
- Visuals of the operation- time lapse
Link Macfarlane : I am wearing a mask, so you cant see the huge smile that is on my face , its unbelievable to see so many people , these are like our real super heroes , all of them are huddled around this one life , seeing all the instrumentation that has been bought by the Making a difference trust and knowing its not just this baby but many others to follow whose lives are going to be changed forever//
V/O Because of limited space Project architect Rudolph Coetzee- from Hospital Design Group had to come up with a more innovative design.
Upsound : Rudolph: 01:25 Its small for an ICU , its a two Bed facility and I think the full area we have got to work with is has a lot of constraints in that , but if you understand and have a good team behind you, and you understand the functionality of an ICU unit like that then you start seeing the unused spaces that’s up for the taking to make it work, so we’ve used the nooks and crannies we don’t usually utilise in a normal ICU, so the design that came out is quite different as well and that is just because of the constraints and the brief we have had to put in two ICU beds in that space , has a lot of impact in a small area.
V/O After months of delays due to the Covid-19 pandemic ,thanks to the tireless efforts of partners and donors patron of the trust Karolina Adropolous was on hand to officially hand over the building site.
Upsound Karolina at Site hand over: We can formally say that site hand over is officially concluded, this to november 2020, hellish circumstance not withstanding we carry on may we shake on that...we officially hand over [ Clapping and “Elbow shake”]

Upsound :01 :41 Medical Manager Dr Kurt Maart:.//I think with these two units we have built something that is a place of excellence, we are looking forward to the day we can fully exploit these two cardiothoracic bed units in order to help kids with heart problems that can be cured in the western cape

V/O Thanks to the generosity of donors The Carte Blanche Making A Difference Trust hopes completion of this project will mean more infants & children will be given immediate access to life saving treatment and that no child is ever turned away..

---- End ----
